baseline._note_per_mode_counts: per-mode latency counts/means shown here are from the same run's per-mode stage-level stats (run_mode's own dedicated print, one heartbeat-window snapshot); the overall total_cycles/cycles_per_transaction figures are the run's final aggregate across ALL stages including the 3 dense adversarial stages, so per-mode counts do not sum to 1,310,000 by themselves -- see results/b1-comparison.md for the full breakdown.

collateral_slowdown_vs_baseline._note: Q8_DEC and Q4_DEC never touch q8_scale_dual_radix4 -- their own mean-latency increase is entirely collateral, caused by q8enc_inflight's full-serialization gate blocking ALL issuance (including Q4_0 decode/encode and Q8_0 decode) for the dual-radix4 variant's much longer (~330-cycle mean vs ~54-cycle mean) Q8_0 encode in-flight window, so those transactions queue longer in the input FIFO before being issued -- not a change to their own datapath latency.

assertions.note: Both Verilator builds compiled with --assert; membrane_quant_stream_top_q8_dual_radix4.sv's own internal assertions (in_flight range, 3-way retire mutual exclusion, single-in-flight discipline, q8_scale_dual_radix4's own atomic-acceptance/rendezvous-symmetry assertions) were live and did not fire.
